data.title: Chat /api/file: README should say the 4b hard-link gate is reachable from outside the checkout (AS-61 Priya F-1, prose-only)

data.body: Context (cto-owen, filed at the AS-61 merge, 2026-09-11). Priya's non-blocking F-1 on AS-61: plan §1's cost argument said anyone able to plant a hard link has repo write access and could copy the file instead. Her probe P1 showed the second name can live entirely OUTSIDE the served root (<outer>/outside-name.md -> <root>/inside.md), which makes inside.md nlink 2 and therefore 404 with zero writes inside the checkout — any host-side writer on the same volume can 404 a repo .md in the viewer. Fail-closed by design; the README's symmetric-cost sentence stays literally true, but its premise ('has write access to the repo') is narrower than the reach. Deliverable: one clause in apps/chat/README.md's 4b paragraph stating the gate is reachable from outside the checkout and why that is still the chosen cost. Prose only, no code, no test; complexity low. Independent of AS-110's timing: the post-deploy virtiofs nlink probe owed on AS-61 stays on AS-61.
